decision.rationale: The official UBC Open Case Studies project publishes interdisciplinary open educational resources for anyone at UBC or elsewhere. Its faculty-and-student collaboration is an institutional teaching resource, not a personal or student-run site, and its stated scope is not Okanagan-exclusive. Academic content is the host purpose, with observed participation and practical website-help sections overriding the fallback. Neither this hostname nor its observed cases.sites.olt.ubc.ca alias appears in the published host index.
evidence: https://cases.open.ubc.ca/ | ad439c530b0e9300080073be5c2238d2edfc0880251d0c3a890b093b23c4bb6f | This project brings together faculty and students from across departments and Faculties to co-create an interdisciplinary, open educational resource with case studies that can be used by anyone, at UBC or elsewhere.

https://cases.open.ubc.ca/ | ad439c530b0e9300080073be5c2238d2edfc0880251d0c3a890b093b23c4bb6f | The cases on this site are open educational resources: they have an open license to allow for revision and reuse of the cases in other courses and contexts (the cases are licensed CC BY 4.0).

https://cases.open.ubc.ca/ | ad439c530b0e9300080073be5c2238d2edfc0880251d0c3a890b093b23c4bb6f | Get Involved: There are several ways to contribute to the Open Case Studies project: use a case study in your course, comment on the case studies, create a new open case study or spread the word! Navigation links /get-involved/.

https://cases.open.ubc.ca/ | ad439c530b0e9300080073be5c2238d2edfc0880251d0c3a890b093b23c4bb6f | Navigation includes Teaching Guide (/teaching-guide/), Case Implementation (/teaching-with-the-cases/), Using the Open Case Studies Website (/using-the-open-case-studies-website/), Using the UBC Wiki (/wiki-guide/), and Contact Us (/contact-us/).

rules.rationale: The homepage invites faculty and students to contribute, reuse, revise, or create case studies through Get Involved.
Observed website-use, wiki-use, and contact links provide practical help using or contributing to the resource.
The observed case studies, teaching guide, implementation guide, and open-educational-resource guide directly support teaching and learning.

fallback.rationale: The institutional purpose is interdisciplinary open educational case studies and teaching resources for UBC and broader reuse.
